title: fix(spec): one rename rule for every unknown-key suggester
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuRTHmmdYhGsPrpf8EzYYxUk)_
Part of #35420 — the shared budget rule lands here; the retired-key half (the card's last sentence) needs no code change under the standing ruling, see Acceptance notes. The card is closed by hand after merge with that reading.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:元数据作者在对象定义或种子数据里写错一个很短的键名时,报错不再附带一个毫不相干的"你是不是想写"建议;真正差一个字母或两个字母互换的笔误仍会被提示,其余入口不变。
- 为什么做:这是上一轮"短键名拼写建议收紧"的收尾,把同一条规则推到另外两个还在各自计算的报错入口,替编写元数据的作者(多数是 AI)解决被错误建议带偏的问题。
- 出错会怎样:最坏只是报错里的建议文字不准或缺失,任何键的接受与拒绝都不变,可以直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:无需你操作。卡片最后一句（退役旧键是否还附带拼写改名建议）按已有裁决处理:ADR-0087 2026-10-26 修订（#25767 D2=A）规定退役超过一个大版本的键按普通未知键拒绝、给出最接近的拼写并指向协议升级指南,现状正是如此,不改代码,也不另行请你裁定。

## What changes

One rename rule for every unknown-key suggester in `packages/spec`, in a new leaf module `packages/spec/src/shared/rename-guess.ts` (imports nothing; not re-exported from `shared/index.ts`, like `alias-probe.ts`):

- `renameBudget(key)` = `max(2, floor(len / 3))`, and `suggestRename(key, knownKeys)` = the settled rule from the strict refusal: above five characters the first `findClosestMatches` answer inside the budget; at five or fewer only a candidate one edit away, an adjacent swap counted as one; nothing for an empty key.
- `levenshteinDistance` and `findClosestMatches` moved into the leaf with their docblocks verbatim and are re-exported from `suggestions.zod.ts`, so the published names and import path are unchanged (`check:api-surface` green; `export-origins/` regenerated for the two moved origins). The leaf exists so `data/*.zod.ts` can share the rule without a cycle through `suggestions.zod.ts` and without adding a published export.
- Doors now calling it: `strictUnknownKeyError` (unchanged behaviour), `ObjectSchema.create()` (its private `editDistance` + `suggestKey` copy is deleted) `defineSeed` (its inline `max(2, floor(len / 3))` is deleted) and the authoring-key lint `lintAuthoredRecordKeys` in `data/authoring-key-lint.ts`, which `defineStack` and the CLI report through (its flat `findClosestMatches(key, candidates, 3, 1)` is replaced; the `hint?.to ?? (hint?.why ? undefined : …)` precedence is unchanged). The leaf's header now names every unknown-key door; the value-vocabulary suggesters (`error-map.zod.ts` enum hint, `suggestFieldType`) stay on `findClosestMatches`' default on purpose.
- `field-value.zod.ts` and `default-value-shape.ts` held no code copy: they read the rule through `strictObject` already. Their comments restated the old budget and lookup and now name `suggestRename`.
- The `strictUnknownKeyError` docblock said its fallback matched `suggestKey` in `object.zod.ts` (comment 7004171725); it now names `suggestRename`, which both doors call, so the sentence is true by construction.
- Nit: the header of `packages/rest/src/rest-meta-packaged-action-permission-refusal.test.ts` named the retired data route for the permission-set clone; it now names `POST /api/v1/security/permission-sets/:name/clone`, the route the regime table's refusal spells.

Observable change, suggestion text only: `ObjectSchema.create({ page: 1 })` no longer says "did you mean `name`", `defineSeed` no longer answers a record key `kind` with `id`, and the authoring-key report no longer answers `aria` with `areas` or an eight-character key three edits away (`descrptn`) at all, while `dfltValue` → `defaultValue` (nine characters, budget 3) is still answered. One-edit slips (`nmae`, `labl`, `queeu`) are still answered. No key is accepted or refused differently.

## Tests

<details><summary>Pins, one per door, plus the rule and a class guard</summary>

- `data/object.test.ts`: `page` gets no rename; `nmae` → `name`, `labl` → `label` still answered.
- `data/define-seed-record-keys.test.ts`: `kind` gets no rename; `queeu` → `queue` (adjacent swap) still answered.
- `data/field-value.test.ts`: `LocationValueSchema` `lon` gets no rename; `lgn` → `lng` still answered.
- `data/default-value-shape.test.ts`: `checkLiteralDefaultValue` on a location default, same pair.
- `data/authoring-key-lint.test.ts`: `aria` gets no rename; `lable` and `lbael` → `label` still answered; `descrptn` (8 characters, 3 edits) gets nothing while `dfltValue` (9 characters, 3 edits) → `defaultValue`.
- `shared/suggestions.test.ts`: `renameBudget`, `suggestRename` (short, long, empty key), and a guard that no non-test source file under `packages/spec/src` other than `rename-guess.ts` spells `Math.max(2, Math.floor(` or hands `findClosestMatches` its own distance (a third argument) in code (comment lines skipped).
- The strict door's own pins stay in `shared/strict-object.test.ts` (unchanged).

</details>

- Ablation at 945afc35: the call site reverted to `findClosestMatches(key, candidates, 3, 1)[0]` (import held, then the call replaced; both anchors x1 then x0, blob ebad5a51 to ad0aef4d): `authoring-key-lint.test.ts` + `suggestions.test.ts` → 3 failed / 54 passed (the short-key and length-relative cases and the class guard red; the one-edit slip control stays green). Restored: blob == HEAD ebad5a51, `git diff HEAD` empty.

Restored by the tool; working blob hash equal to the HEAD blob 06f10119, `git diff HEAD` empty. Expected direction (red) observed.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **The retired-key half needs no change: the standing ruling covers it.** Measured at the `/meta` write door (the real `PUT /api/v1/meta/:type/:name` route handler of an in-process `RestServer` over a real `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` and `SchemaRegistry`, built dists, head b8bdbfba): a form view body with `defaultSort` answers `422 INVALID_METADATA` with "Unrecognized key(s) on this inline form view: `defaultSort`. Did you mean `defaultSort` → `defaults`? Keys retired before the previous protocol major are no longer prescribed here — see the protocol upgrade guide…", and the `unrecognized_keys` entry in `issues[]` names the upgrade guide too. The same probe with `aria` answers with no guess (the short-key rule working at the door). The ADR-0087 2026-10-26 amendment (#25767 D2 = A) rules that once a retirement kit ages out "a removed key is refused as a strict unknown key whose refusal names the protocol upgrade guide" (ADR-0087 status line; the same words under D2), which is exactly the reading above. The amendment is silent on the rename guess a strict unknown-key refusal carries, so the guess stays the ordinary strict-refusal behaviour. Keeping a rename guess off a retired key would mean the spec remembers aged-out keys again, which that amendment chose not to do. The seat routed this half to that ruling (no B or C option, nothing put to the maintainer); the card is closed after merge citing this reading.
- The retired checklist item `access-security.packaged-permission-set-lifecycle` was left unchanged: its title already says "at the retired sys_permission_set data door" and its `retiredReason` already names `POST /api/v1/security/permission-sets/:name/clone`; its steps describe what the item tested before it retired.
- Other copies of the budget, outside this diff's reach, reported to the seat and not changed here: `packages/formula/src/validate.ts` (`nearest`), `packages/lint/src/object-graph.ts`, `packages/cli/src/utils/collect-docs.ts`. Prose that still describes the pre-screen budget: `kernel/manifest.zod.ts` (the `hosts` alias comment says the fallback would answer `hooks`; the short-key screen now refuses that guess on its own, so the alias fills a gap rather than overruling a wrong answer).

## Out of scope

Other copies of the rename budget, found by grep and not changed here. None was measured at a public door, and no card is filed:

- `packages/formula/src/validate.ts:1497` (`nearest`): `max(2, floor(len / 3))` without the short-key screen.
- `packages/lint/src/object-graph.ts:809`: the same budget, without the screen.
- `packages/cli/src/utils/collect-docs.ts:974`: the same budget, without the screen.

## Verification

Read first, by risk:
1. `packages/spec/src/shared/rename-guess.ts` — `suggestRename` (the moved rule; the empty-key guard moved into it).
2. `packages/spec/src/shared/suggestions.zod.ts` — the re-export line and the `strictUnknownKeyError` call site.
3. `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts` — `unknownKeyError` now calls `suggestRename`.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/data/object.test.ts src/data/define-seed-record-keys.test.ts` — expect both files green, including the two new `a short unknown key gets the shared rename rule` describes.
